name: Stefan Meier
bio:
Stefan Meier's journey into motorsport IT began unconventionally, not with a childhood obsession with racing, but with a fascination for data integrity. After completing his degree in computer science at ETH Zurich, he initially worked in the banking sector. However, the allure of real-time data analysis under pressure drew him to the fast-paced world of racing. He joined ProSport Racing five years ago, initially as a junior analyst, quickly rising through the ranks to become the IT Systems Manager.

Stefan is known for his meticulous approach to system maintenance and his ability to troubleshoot complex issues under immense pressure. He believes that a robust and reliable IT infrastructure is crucial for gaining a competitive edge in motorsport. He is constantly seeking innovative ways to improve data acquisition, analysis, and communication within the team. His focus on precision and dedication to continual improvement sets him apart.

Beyond his technical skills, Stefan's quiet demeanor and calm under pressure make him a valuable asset to the team during race weekends. He's not one for the spotlight, preferring to let his work speak for itself, ensuring that the team's data flows smoothly and that any potential disruptions are addressed swiftly and efficiently.

physical.description: Stefan has a slightly wiry build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small Swiss Army knife, even in the office.
Has a peculiar habit of organizing his desk based on the last digit of the current date.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, claiming it provides superior tactile feedback.
